requirements.title: Project must have .fusa.json configuration
Project must have a Java build file
Project must have a LICENSE file
Project must have a README
Project must have CI configuration
Engine must run all registered rules
Engine must isolate rule failures so one rule does not prevent others from running
Engine must distinguish ERROR, WARNING, INFO severity
Engine must honour rule exclusions from config
Engine must support filtered rule runs
Statement coverage must meet configured threshold
Trace must support parent_id on requirements to model HLR/LLR hierarchy
Trace must validate HLR/LLR hierarchy: orphan LLRs and childless HLRs are violations
Qualify must support qualification_method, qualifier_identity, and qualification_record_uri fields
Qualify must support V&V independence fields and compute independence status
Coverage must support MC/DC analysis from LLVM coverage JSON export
Tool qualification report (qualify-report.json) must be present
Test evidence bundle (.fusa-evidence.json) must be present
All annotated requirements must have at least one //fusa:test reference
Trace must support --func-coverage N gating on percentage of public functions carrying a //fusa:req tag
Trace must flag //fusa:test tags whose id is not registered in .fusa-reqs.json as a dangling reference (check WARNING, rule TRACE002)
Trace.buildMatrix() must aggregate scanned annotations into a per-requirement traceability matrix
Engine registry mustRegister() must wrap registration failures in IllegalStateException
Engine registry register() must reject null rules and duplicate rule ids
Engine.run() must execute all registered rules with no filter (default entry point)
Detect returning null from non-void methods without //fusa:unsafe
System.exit() calls must be annotated //fusa:safe-state
Raw Thread creation must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Static mutable fields require //fusa:shared annotation
Floating-point equality comparison must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Recursive methods require //fusa:recursive <max-depth> annotation
System.out/err usage in non-test code must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
Reflection usage requires //fusa:reflect annotation
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked") usage must be flagged unless annotated //fusa:unsafe
@Deprecated API usage must be tracked for migration before certification
SBOM (sbom.json) must be present for supply-chain compliance
Build provenance (provenance.json) must be present for SLSA compliance
Sign.generateKey() must generate and persist a new HMAC-SHA256 key
Sign.sign() must compute and persist an HMAC-SHA256 signature for an artifact
Sign.verify() must validate an artifact's signature against its stored HMAC-SHA256 value
Hara.deriveAsil() must derive an ASIL rating from Severity/Exposure/Controllability per ISO 26262-3 Table 4
